name: cloud-skills-mcp
description: Six-cloud Skills for the cloud-skills-mcp MCP server: operate AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, and Baidu AI Cloud through official HTTPS/WSS APIs with internal identity-chain credentials.

interface.shortDescription: Operate six clouds through the cloud-skills-mcp MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Six direct-network skills (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Baidu AI Cloud) that drive the cloud-skills-mcp stdio MCP server's 19 tools. Credentials never enter MCP arguments: each provider's official identity chain is resolved lazily in the server process, and every protocol family is covered by hermetic tests, protocol smoke, and a scheme mapping audit.
